mandarin.normalization: NFKC; lowercase; ü->v; explicit u<codepoint> token for unconverted Han

fresh_final_harness.ranking: stable corpus order among exact v2 phonetic-key matches; dedupe by entity id
fresh_final_harness.perturbation: first eligible Han replaced by deterministic alternate Han sharing the same tone-free pinyin syllable
fresh_final_harness.negative_policy: five fixed ordinary Mandarin utterances must yield no exact phonetic entity candidate
fresh_final_harness.pass_policy: at least 40 positives; zero gold misses; all negatives abstain; zero unknown Han

architecture_boundary: Unit 06 exposed final is retired from unseen evidence and cannot be used for tuning.
No product wiring or brain promotion is part of this freeze.
After the fresh final is opened, any encoder, ranking, candidate-budget, perturbation, partition or abstention-policy change invalidates that final as unseen evidence.
A failed one-shot final must be diagnosed broadly; it may not be patched by exposed case identity.
